title: Failure Forensics | Trace the mistake, not just the final answer
text: A real app walkthrough using an invented invoice and a deliberately injected error.

title: 01 / Start with a document
text: The source says 814 EUR. This synthetic example deliberately extracts 999 EUR.

title: 02 / A finished run can still contain a wrong answer
text: Processing status and content quality are kept separate. Findings remain hypotheses.

title: 03 / Follow the actual dependencies
text: Extraction and classification branch independently. The summary uses both and the source.

title: 04 / Compare evidence with the output
text: Source: 814 EUR. Extracted fact: 999 EUR. The suspected starting point is visible.

title: 05 / Human review stays in control
text: Confirm, correct or mark a finding as uncertain. No label is silently treated as ground truth.

title: 06 / Change one fact, then test the result
text: Correct 999 to 814 using a normal input. Keep the original run intact.

title: 07 / Inspect what changed
text: The replay updates affected steps. A changed result is evidence to investigate, not proof of causality.

title: 08 / Turn reviewed examples into repeatable evaluation
text: Save reviewed cases in versioned datasets. The demo measures mechanics, not real-model accuracy.

title: Built with React, TypeScript, FastAPI and SQLAlchemy
text: Groq / local Ollama adapters • durable tracing • evidence review • controlled replay
